title: su2-heatbath-gpu: SU(2) Wilson-action heat-bath generator for GPUs (HIP and CUDA)
description:
A small Monte Carlo generator of SU(2) pure-gauge configurations with the Wilson action on a periodic four-dimensional lattice, in double precision, for AMD (HIP) and NVIDIA (CUDA) GPUs. Exact heat bath (Creutz / Kennedy-Pendleton) plus overrelaxation, checkerboard updates and counter-based Philox4x32-10 random numbers: on a given GPU and build, runs are reproducible bit for bit.

The repository contains the HIP source and its mechanical CUDA port, a CPU (OpenMP) transcription of the same algorithm used as a throughput baseline, an independent CPU Metropolis reference, a test suite with criteria frozen before the first run, bit-level anchors to archived runs, measured throughputs (link updates per second) and a description of silent data corruption observed on an AMD integrated GPU. It is a tool, not a physics result.

The code and documentation were written by AI coding agents under the direction of the author; see AI_USE.md.
notes: Tested on an AMD Radeon 8060S (gfx1151, ROCm 7.1) and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (sm_120, CUDA 13.3). See README.md for the measured throughputs, docs/VALIDATION.md for the validation and AI_USE.md for the use of AI.
